name: Lila Abu-Lughod
shortBio: Palestinian-American social theorist and anthropologist whose work on emotion, Bedouin poetry, and postcolonial gender politics dismantled Western "saving Muslim women" rescue narratives and Eurocentric psychology of affect.
centralQuestion: How do cultural poetics of emotion challenge universalist Western psychology, and why do imperial "saving Muslim women" discourses obscure structural geopolitics?

keyWorks.title: Veiled Sentiments: Honor and Poetry in a Bedouin Society
keyWorks.description: Landmark study in cultural psychology and sociology showing how Bedouin oral lyric poetry expresses vulnerability within honor codes.

keyWorks.title: Do Muslim Women Need Saving?
keyWorks.description: Critiques Western liberal-imperial humanitarianism that reduces geopolitical violence to "culture" or Islam.
